stories.headline: DeepSeek in Talks for $12B Tencent-Backed Funding
stories.blurb: DeepSeek is reportedly in negotiations to raise at least $12 billion in a funding round backed by Tencent, highlighting the aggressive global investment race for AI dominance.

stories.headline: Wall Street Arranges Historic $60B Chip Deal for Anthropic
stories.blurb: Wall Street banks are organizing a massive $60 billion transaction to secure advanced chips for Anthropic, illustrating the soaring capital expenditures required to sustain frontier AI development.

stories.headline: Reflection Launches Beam, a 501B Open-Weight Model
stories.blurb: Reflection has released Beam, a massive 501-billion-parameter open-weight model, raising the competitive stakes for open-source AI capabilities.

stories.headline: Autonomous AI Secures First US Drug Prescription Approval
stories.blurb: In a landmark US pilot, Nolla Health will use AI to diagnose and prescribe acne medications to Utah patients without direct human physician oversight.

stories.headline: Structural Vulnerability Discovered in Model Context Protocol
stories.blurb: A structural vulnerability discovered in AI agents from Google and other providers exposes systemic security flaws in Anthropic’s Model Context Protocol framework.

stories.headline: Researcher Claims Critical KVM Guest-Host Escape
stories.blurb: A security researcher claims to have discovered a guest-to-host escape vulnerability in the Kernel-based Virtual Machine, posing a potentially severe threat to cloud and virtualization infrastructure.

stories.headline: Apple Introduces OS-Level Controls for AI Agent Risks
stories.blurb: Apple is rolling out new macOS controls designed to block unauthorized or rogue actions by local AI agents, marking the industry's first native OS-level safeguard targeting agentic risks.

stories.headline: SubQuery Supply Chain Compromised with Hidden Backdoors
stories.blurb: A newly disclosed supply chain compromise in the SubQuery ecosystem demonstrates the sophisticated use of hidden credential theft and persistent backdoors.

stories.headline: Mold Linker Releases Version 3.0.0
stories.blurb: The high-performance linker mold has officially released version 3.0.0, introducing critical architecture enhancements and performance optimizations for systems developers.

stories.headline: Early Metadata Generation Halves Rust Build Times
stories.blurb: A new compiler technique that emits crate metadata early can double the speed of Rust development checks and builds.

stories.headline: AMD Unveils ROCm 10.1 to Tackle GPU Data Bottlenecks
stories.blurb: AMD has released ROCm 10.1 with major software-level optimizations designed to break the data-movement bottleneck for massive GPU clusters.

stories.headline: Schneider Electric Acquires PTC for $22.6B Amid Datacenter Boom
stories.blurb: Driven by the ongoing datacenter infrastructure boom, Schneider Electric is acquiring PTC in a massive $22.6 billion deal to bolster its industrial software and power management assets.
